finalizationAction: Confirm, finalize and send to signing
finalizedTextStatus: Contract text finalized. Nothing has been sent.

signingVerification.notice: Create a separate non-binding copy using this artist’s reviewed details. Signing it does not execute a contract, activate a partnership or change Studio access.
signingVerification.confirm: I authorize this non-binding signing verification for the selected artist.
signingVerification.created: Verification copy created. Open Signing to read and sign it.
signingVerification.error: The verification copy was not confirmed. Refresh Signing before trying again.

verificationEmail.subject: Your Artanrecords signing verification
verificationEmail.body:
Your non-binding signing verification is ready.

Open this private page:
{url}

Verify your email using the code, then read the document, add initials and record your verification signature. This link expires on {expiry}.

This separate copy tests signing only. It does not execute a contract, activate a partnership or change Studio access.

verificationEmail.issued: Non-binding verification copy created. Send this private invitation to the artist.
verificationEmail.emailAccepted: Verification invitation accepted by iCloud for sending. Delivery is not yet confirmed.

draftPreparation.title: Terms
draftPreparation.blocked: Not sent. Complete the remaining terms for legal review. Real-contract issuing is not enabled yet.
draftPreparation.ready: All required placeholders are complete. Legal review and an enabled real-contract issuing workflow are still required before sending.
draftPreparation.label details: Label legal capacity, registration and address

artistActions.title: Artist options
artistActions.saved: Correction saved as a new version. Review it before using it in a contract.
artistActions.failed: The correction was not confirmed. Reload the current details before trying again.
artistActions.exportNotice: Private details record. This is not a signed agreement.
artistActions.archiveNotice: Archive this agreement workspace? The account, Studio access, public profile and contract history will not be changed.

artistSearch.title: Find artist
artistSearch.placeholder: Name, username, account ID or submission reference
artistSearch.select: Select an artist from the results.
artistSearch.empty: No linked artist account found. Check the reference or review the original submission.
artistSearch.unavailable: Artist search is unavailable. No account has been selected.

issuance.title: Prepare label signature
issuance.saveFirst: Save the contract before preparing it for signature.
issuance.unavailable: Real contract issuing is not enabled. This preview has not been sent.
issuance.finalTextRequired: Prepare the final text and record legal approval before issuing. Draft and non-binding wording must be resolved in the document itself.
issuance.recipientRequired: Open the artist's current reviewed details before issuing this document.
issuance.partiesRequired: Confirm separate artist and label signers before issuing this agreement.
issuance.boundary: Both parties sign this fixed version. Studio access remains locked until final owner approval.
issuance.confirm: I reviewed this exact final text, the parties and the agreed access dates, and authorize issuing it for signature.
issuance.dateError: Choose an end date after the start date.
issuance.finalConfirm: Fix this exact contract for signing? The next step is your label signature. Nothing is emailed or activated by this confirmation.
issuance.issueError: The contract was not confirmed as issued. Refresh and check Signing before trying again.
issuance.issued: Contract fixed. Complete the label signature before sending the invitation to the artist.
issuance.linkError: The fixed contract exists, but its email link could not be prepared. Do not create another contract. Open its signing record for follow-up.

issuance.body:
Your agreement is ready.

Open your private agreement:
{url}

Verify this email address using the code shown in your verification email, then read and sign the document. This invitation expires on {expiry}.

After both parties sign, Control Center completes the final review before Studio access is activated. You will not receive a reusable password in this email.
